2607.13396.title: Set-shifting Behavioral Test for Harnessed Agents
2607.13396.paper_summary: What happens to an LLM agent's tool choice when the reliable tool silently changes within an ongoing session? We borrow set-shifting from cognitive psychology to study how well agents adapt to hidden reliability shifts. Our benchmark mounts tool-skill libraries with redundancies, where many tools solve the same task but differ in hidden reliability. In our evaluation framework, a branched schedule shifts the reliable tool group at hidden boundaries and pairs every shift with a no-shift control. We find that agents, by default, settle on a small recurring routine within a few turns of each boundary, with call shares concentrating on a few discrete values after each reliability shift. We score the set-shifting accuracy for each agent trajectory: the joint probability of routing to the target tool group in every post-shift window. We test open-weight LLMs in an open-source agentic harness and find qualitatively distinct failure modes across the same set of routines. We also find that set framing, how the toolset presents the alternatives as competing or complementary, shifts the routing dynamics.
2607.13396.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人的工具選擇在持續的會話中，當可靠工具默默變更時會發生什麼？我們借用認知心理學中的集合轉換來研究代理人如何適應隱藏的可靠性變化。 我們的基準建立了具有冗餘的工具技能庫，其中許多工具解決相同的任務，但在隱藏的可靠性上有所不同。在我們的評估框架中，一個分支計劃在隱藏邊界處轉換可靠工具組，並將每次轉換與無轉換的控制組配對。我們發現，代理人默認情況下在每個邊界的幾回合內會固定在一個小的重複例行中，並且在每次可靠性變化後，呼叫比例集中在幾個離散的值上。我們為每個代理人軌跡計算集合轉換的準確性：在每個變更後窗口中路由到目標工具組的聯合概率。我們在開源的代理框架中測試開放權重的 LLM，並發現相同例行中存在質量上不同的失敗模式。我們還發現，集合框架，即工具集如何將選擇呈現為競爭或互補，會改變路由動態。
2607.13396.author: Ziwei Ye et.al.
